items.title: SPS to tighten student tech policies this week for students in grades 3 to 5
items.summary:
SEATTLE — Seattle Public Schools (SPS) is tightening its technology rules for some students this week, adding new limits aimed at reducing distractions and curbing reliance on generative AI tools.

Superintendent Ben Shuldiner said that when he arrived in Seattle, it was clear the district had “steered too heavily into an overreliance of technology.” [...] RELATED | Seattle schools to cap elementary students' screen time, block unapproved AI tools

Parents have been asking the district to review how technology is used in classrooms, saying students are getting distracted or relying too heavily on generative AI tools. [...] Under the changes, students in grades three through five will have a one-hour daily cap on screen time. The limit includes activities such as watching a 10-minute educational video.

The district will also no longer allow iPads and laptops to be used as incentives or rewards. In addition, Seattle Public Schools is blocking access to Minecraft, YouTube and Gemini, programs Shuldiner said have been "abused."

Marvell Technology sells wired networking and data infrastructure chips that process and move data within data centers and telecommunications networks to cloud providers and equipment makers. While adding optical laser manufacturing expands the target market for artificial intelligence connectivity, paying a fivefold premium over Lumentum's share price from a year ago strains balance-sheet discipline. Marvell's $115 billion acquisition of Lumentum shifts the investment case from a high-margin [...] Lumentum manufactures laser components and optical transceivers that convert light signals into electronic data inside high-speed networks. Combining those optical lasers with Marvell's electronic digital signal processors allows the buyer to offer integrated optical interconnect modules for data centers. However, regulators in China and the U.S. must approve the tie-up, a process management expects could stretch into early 2028. Analysts also warned that Lumentum competes with several of [...] ## What's next for Marvell Technology

Investors will get their next operational update when Marvell reports fiscal third-quarter results on Dec. 1, 2026. Management narrowed its preliminary quarterly revenue guidance to approximately $3.2 billion, but near-term financial results are taking a back seat to deal execution risks. The stock is down 57.2% (as of the close on Friday, Nov. 6) from its 52-week high of $329.88, reflecting how sharply sentiment turned following the merger news.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Chào bạn, đây là một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng **recursion** (đệ quy). Hàm này gọi chính nó để tính toán các số trước đó cho đến khi đạt đến các trường hợp cơ bản (base case).

```python
def fibonacci(n):
    """
    Tính số Fibonacci thứ n bằng recursion.
    
    Tham số:
        n (int): Vị trí trong dãy Fibonacci (n >= 0)
    
    Trả về:
        int: Giá trị Fibonacci tại vị trí n
    """
    # Trường hợp cơ bản: F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    # Trường hợp đệ quy: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)
    else:
        return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)


# Ví dụ sử dụng:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        n = int(input("Nhập vị trí n (n >= 0): "))
        if n < 0:
            print("Vui lòng nhập số nguyên không âm.")
        else:
            print(f"Fibonacci({n}) = {fibonacci(n)}")
    except ValueError:
        print("Vui lòng nhập một số nguyên hợp lệ.")
```

**Giải thích ngắn:**
- Hàm kiểm tra `n` nhỏ hơn hoặc bằng 0 trả về `0`.
- Nếu `n` bằng 1 trả về `1`.
- Các trường hợp khác sẽ gọi lại `fibonacci(n-1)` và `fibonacci(n-2)` và cộng kết quả lại.

Lưu ý: Cách này dễ hiểu nhưng có hiệu suất thấp cho các giá trị `n` lớn vì tính toán lại nhiều lần cùng kết quả. Nếu bạn cần hiệu suất cao, có thể dùng **memoization** (lưu kết quả đã tính) hoặc phương pháp lặp (iteration).

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar on Friday said the company will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure, even after voters strongly rebuked data centers during Tuesday's midterm elections. [...] OpenAI depends on data centers to train its AI models and serve customers, and Friar said she doesn't think the midterms dramatically changed anything for the company.

"If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we're going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said. "It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital."
